stories.summary: A spate of missed bin collections in Flintshire this summer was due in part to concerns about the health of bin crews. stories.title: Replacement buses for Flint and Shotton as North Wales Coast line closes for three weeks
stories.summary: No trains will call at Flint or Shotton on the North Wales Coast line for three weeks in January while Network Rail carries out £25m of engineering work. stories.summary: A 46-year-old man has been arrested on suspicion of aggravated burglary and affray after police went to an address on Church Street in Connah’s Quay.
